# Skin tokens

<!-- Generated by `node ui/scripts/skins.mjs docs` from ui/src/lib/skins/tokens.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every color a skin can set. Each token is a CSS custom property (`--name`) and goes into the
`light` and/or `dark` object of a skin file — see [Creating skins](../guide/creating-skins.md).

A token a skin leaves out comes from its base skin. When the skin sets a token that another one
is **derived from**, the derived token is computed from the new value instead (unless the skin sets
it too). *Optional* tokens have no value until a skin sets one.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bg` | Window background: around the panels and behind the active session tab. | — | `#eef0f3` | `#111316` |

| `surface` | Panels, dialogs, menus and cards. | — | `#ffffff` | `#1c1f24` |

## Palette

Nine hues that file icons, status colors, the terminal and the syntax highlighting are derived from. Setting just the palette gives a skin consistent colors everywhere.

| Token | Used for | Derived from | Default light | Default dark |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `red` | Palette hue "red". File icons, status, terminal and syntax colors are derived from the palette. | — | `#cc2f35` | `#f0595e` |
| `orange` | Palette hue "orange". File icons, status, terminal and syntax colors are derived from the palette. | — | `#c96a1e` | `#f08a55` |

| `cyan` | Palette hue "cyan". File icons, status, terminal and syntax colors are derived from the palette. | — | `#0b86a0` | `#3db8d0` |
| `blue` | Palette hue "blue". File icons, status, terminal and syntax colors are derived from the palette. | — | `#2563d9` | `#6aa0f8` |

## Menu bar and function key bar

All optional: they let a skin color the menu bar and the function keys differently from the rest of the chrome (the classic cyan bars of *Retro Blue*).

| Token | Used for | Derived from | Default light | Default dark |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `menubar-bg` | Background of the menu bar. Optional: default is "chrome". | *optional* | — | — |
| `menubar-fg` | Menu titles and toolbar icons. Optional. | *optional* | — | — |
| `key-bg` | Background of the function key labels (F1–F10). Optional: default is "surface-3". | *optional* | — | — |
| `key-fg` | Text of the function key labels. Optional: default is "text-2". | *optional* | — | — |
| `key-num` | Numbers of the function keys. Optional: default is "muted". | *optional* | — | — |

## Style

Not colors: the `style` object of a skin applies to both variants.

| Key | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `fontUi` | CSS font-family list of the user interface | the system font |
| `fontMono` | CSS font-family list for paths, permissions, code | the system monospace font |
| `radius` | corner radius of buttons and inputs, 0–16 px | `6` |
| `panelRadius` | corner radius of panels, menus and dialogs, 0–24 px | `9` |
| `density` | row height of the file lists: `"compact"`, `"normal"`, `"comfortable"` | `"normal"` |
| `listFontSize` | font size of the file lists, 10–20 px | `13` |
| `stripes` | `true` for alternating row backgrounds (`row-alt`) | `false` |
